card: Jäger: fought with the Jäger Battalion at Misse, the Gulf of Riga and the Aa river, 1916-17.
First Finnish officer to earn the diploma of the French École Supérieure de Guerre (1921).
Winter War: commander of the 1st Division on the Karelian Isthmus.
Commanded VI Army Corps in the 1944 Soviet offensive; Mannerheim Cross no. 130.
Jäger: served in the Jäger pioneer company.
Winter War: commanded Infantry Regiment 17 in the defence of Summa.
Continuation War: commander of the 11th Division; captured Prääsä in 1941.
Knight of the Mannerheim Cross no. 21 (1941).
Captain of the gunboat Karjala, 1930-32.
Winter War: chief of staff of the Coastal Fleet.
Commanded the coastal defence ship Väinämöinen, 1940-44.
Commander of the Turku Naval Base and commodore, 1944.
Winter War: led Infantry Regiment 16 at Tolvajärvi, December 1939.
Continuation War: commander of the 18th Division, then the 3rd Division.
Credited with the capture of Tornio in the Lapland War, 1944.
Double Knight of the Mannerheim Cross (1941 and 1944).
Jäger: joined Jäger Battalion 27 in 1915.
Winter War: commander of the 7th Division from January 1940.
Led the 6th Division at Ihantala in 1944; killed there by mortar fire.
Knight of the Mannerheim Cross (1941); Mannerheim called him "the brave Major General Vihma".
